name: acs_5year_2023_county
title: ACS 5-Year Estimates 2023 (county) — data contract
who_uses_this: Enrich or validate county-level demographic joins at ingest into your warehouse, or with POST /egress before sharing research exports with a partner or AI agent.
description: Compatible with the US Census Bureau American Community Survey 5-year API; not affiliated with the U.S. Census Bureau. County-level 2023 population and median household income in 2023 inflation-adjusted dollars. A raw Census API pull is strings, including numeric estimates and placeholder codes such as -666666666; B19013_001M is the margin of error and B19013_001MA is its text annotation.
